compiled_state.description:
## Summary

Surfaced immediately AFTER fixing the completion-verifier observed_upsert kwarg TypeError (ticket 9c7c-4844-f53c-4eac, Gerrit 1805, merged). With the signature drift fixed, the completion verifier now runs to a verdict on the bedrock arm, and a DIFFERENT, pre-existing behavioral assertion in the same test fails:

    tests/external/test_completion_banking_behavior_0707.py::test_dense_completion_banks_and_terminates_in_two_of_three_trials

Live run 31870102530 ('Live External Integration', bedrock arm 94977302870): 1 failed, 17 passed. The failure:

    AssertionError: dense completion banking successes=0/3
    trials = [{'banked': 5, 'verdict': 'PASS', 'error': None, 'calls_at_bank': [11, 11, 11, 11, 11], 'evidence_calls': 11}, ...x3]

All 3 trials reached a valid PASS verdict with error=None (the TypeError is gone), banking all 5 criteria — but `_bounded_bank_gaps` (test helper) requires each criterion's FIRST tool-sourced bank to fall within <=3 filesystem-evidence calls of the previous (`all(gap <= 3)`). On this run the bedrock model (bedrock:us.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6) gathered all 11 evidence-tool calls up front, then bulk-banked all 5 criteria at once (calls_at_bank=[11,11,11,11,11] -> gaps=[11,0,0,0,0], first gap 11 > 3), in all 3 trials. So 0/3 met the incremental-banking oracle; the test needs >=2/3.

## Why this is distinct

- This test is bedrock-PINNED (`_MODEL = 'bedrock:us.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6'`, decorated `@skip_unless_provider('bedrock')`), so it only runs on the bedrock arm; the anthropic/openai arms skip it. It is the sole oracle for incremental/bounded banking.
- The 9c7c fix (thread upsert **kwargs through the observation stub) only OBSERVES banking; it does not change model behavior or the banking counters. The failing assertion is about WHEN the model interleaves the record tool with evidence gathering.

## Root cause (to investigate)

Either (a) genuine model-behavior variance/flakiness on bedrock (the model now front-loads evidence gathering and bulk-banks, so the <=3 bounded-gap oracle no longer holds on bedrock), or (b) a real regression in the banking prompt / bounded-search interleaving that suppresses incremental banking. Investigate whether the bulk-bank pattern is stable across reruns (flaky vs deterministic), compare to the last known-green bedrock run, and inspect the completion-verifier banking prompt / bounded-fallback for changes that could have shifted the model from incremental to bulk banking. Decide whether to fix the interleaving behavior or relax/rescope the `_bounded_bank_gaps` oracle for bedrock.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Determine whether the bulk-bank pattern is deterministic or flaky on the bedrock arm (rerun evidence).
- [ ] Either restore incremental banking (gaps <= 3) so >=2/3 trials pass, or rescope/relax the oracle with a documented rationale.
- [ ] test_dense_completion_banks_and_terminates_in_two_of_three_trials passes on the bedrock arm of Live External Integration.

## Testing

- Repeated workflow_dispatch of 'Live External Integration' (bedrock arm) to characterize variance.
- pytest -m 'external' tests/external/test_completion_banking_behavior_0707.py on bedrock creds.
